Name: JP's The Flower Dance Mod
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][center]﻿[color=#00ff00][u]The Flower Dance Mod[/u][/color][/center][/size][/i][/b]

[b][i][color=#ff00ff][size=5]Because dancing can be whatever you want it to be, with whomever you want, whenever you want... Or something like that.[/size][/color][/i][/b]


[b][color=#00ffff][size=4][i]With this mod it is possible to modify the Flower Dance event to allow things such as:[/i][/size][/color][/b]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Mod NPCs joining the dance without needing to dance with the player.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Increase the number of couples dancing at once (up to 12, but this exceeds the map limits, so up to 9 is fine). [/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]That an NPC can dance in either of the two lines (defining their corresponding sprites). [/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Set a partner for an NPC and a probability that they will dance together. [/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Allow two NPCs of the same gender to dance together. [/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]If there are any NPCs left without a partner, they will be randomly paired up for the dance. [/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Allow NPCs that do not dance to be able to do so.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Random couples through GMCM.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia]

[/font][font=Georgia][size=4][b][color=#ff0000]The mod does not make any default settings, so no NPCs can dance on both lines, nor do they have alternative sprites. Anyone interested can make the settings even for vanilla characters, characters that do not normally dance, etc.[/color][/b]
[/size]

[color=#ffff00][size=5][b]In the optional download, I will include a template on how to configure an NPC and Custom NPC to prepare it for the Dance. [/b][/size][/color][color=#ffff00][size=5][b]It's quite simple and easy to configure; the most complicated part would be the alternative sprites. The rest is default.
[/b][/size][/color]

[i][color=#00ff00][size=5][b]That's it, GMCM is very necessary in this mod in order to configure the mod according to your preferences. You will find detailed information in each option. [/b][/size][/color][/i]


[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can also translate and upload the template with the instructions. 
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.

[/font]
